rule: No excluded, interrupted, setup-failed, unreviewed-purpose, pre-fix, or superseded-candidate run contributes to the selected formal or agent aggregates.

excluded.reason: the run ended before every fixture and arm completed
all MCP work was cancelled before a complete answer
setup-only process used to verify the launch path; no task result
the non-Git database path did not exist; the run stopped before a fixture result
fixture lookup used the wrong non-Git key; harness setup defect
WinError 5 prevented deterministic fixture cleanup; no result selected
trials exposed empty optional symbol disambiguators and an unusable raw relation cursor; both product defects were fixed before the selected run
candidate identity changed after a strict-Clippy source correction
candidate identity and compact routing behavior changed
candidate identity changed before the complete final rerun
candidate identity changed after compact startup removed duplicated blocker detail
candidate identity changed after compact startup removed redundant ranking metadata

a stale Q3 trust oracle still required compact connection_counts after that redundant field was intentionally removed; the formal and blind agent trials were rerun completely against the corrected oracle and exact selected runtime
each complete set preceded the final runtime, skill, compact payload, or reviewed-purpose contract; none was cherry-picked into the selected aggregate
purposes were generated suggestions rather than identical reviewed authored responsibilities
used only to validate fixture compatibility, schema feasibility, bounds, or harness behavior
